data.title: Database Access
data.description:
Use `arrow` for remote access to the database. This R code will return summaries for the Lakes variables.

### R

```{r}
# Use code below

all_results <- arrow::open_dataset("s3://anonymous@template-challenge/forecasts/bundled-summaries/project_id=templatecast?endpoint_override=s3.us-east-005.backblazeb2.com&region=us-east-005")
df <- all_results |>
  dplyr::filter(variable %in% c("temperature")) |>
  dplyr::collect()
```

You can use dplyr operations before calling `dplyr::collect()` to `summarise`, `select` columns, and/or `filter` rows prior to pulling the data into a local `data.frame`. Reducing the data that is pulled locally will speed up the data download speed and reduce your memory usage.
